card.name: The 1 in 1.73 m² body surface
card.fires_on: The digit 1 right after a slash in renal function units, as in mL/minute/1.73 m², where a decimal point and 73 come next. It also fires weakly on a digit before a decimal point in a dose range.

modes.label: 1.73 m² unit
modes.description: The number 1 after mL/min/ in eGFR or creatinine clearance thresholds.
modes.example: estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 30 mL/minute/<<1>>.73 m 2 .

modes.label: Digit before decimal
modes.description: A digit inside a dose range, followed by a decimal point.
modes.example: Hydrochlorothiazide is effective in doses of 1<<2>>.5 to 50 mg once

card.writes: It predicts that a decimal point and more digits come next, as in the .73 of 1.73.
card.plain: It marks the 1 in the kidney-function unit mL/min/1.73 m², just before the decimal point.
